intro: The Great Outdoors is an introductory wilderness survival lesson offered to hunters by an experienced scout named Lyreena. It emphasizes the importance of resting beside a campfire to recover and gain the Boosted Rest buff while journeying through the untamed wilds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, hunter. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
